submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on the word that names the outcome or evaluation of a completed narrative event: achievement or change-of-state verbs (save, won, resigned, defeated, consecrated), their outcome nominals (loss, vow), and evaluative or collective complements (such, bravest, essential, range/Reserves), when read after an explicit subject plus event setup; strongest in encyclopedic biographical and historical prose.
